name: Σουβάλα (Αίγινα)
evidence: Souvala: beach bar on the upper level renting sunbeds and umbrellas; adjacent Loutra organized with umbrellas/sunbeds/beach bar (2nd source, independent of round1)

name: Πόρτο Γερμενό
evidence: 2nd source (travel.gr) says Porto Germeno is a FREE beach without organized umbrellas/sunbeds — bring your own; only a cafe/bar nearby. Refutes round1 sunbeds.

name: Μώλος (Κέρκυρα)
evidence: Partly organized around Attika Resort: sunbeds & umbrellas for rent, showers, beach bar and restaurant (terrabook/projectcorfu, independent of round1)

name: Κολώνα (Κύθνος)
evidence: Kolona Center wooden decks rent sets of sunbeds & umbrellas; local beach bar + Kolona Experience restaurant on the beach (greeka/kythnos.net)

name: Αγία Παρασκευή (Κεφαλονιά)
evidence: Sami-Agia Efimia coast: sunbeds for rent in a small park behind the beach, showers/toilets (greeka/amazingkefalonia). Only snack bars/taverna for food → beach bar left null.

name: Άγιος Αντώνιος (Εύβοια)
evidence: Δήμος Καρύστου / karystion.gr list Agios Antonios among the UNORGANIZED beaches of the Karystos gulf (organized ones are Psili Ammos, Dytiki, Alykes). Round1 over-read.

name: Ζέφυρος (Εύβοια)
evidence: No specific 2nd source for a Zefyros beach in Karystos/Evia (only an accommodation listing). Kept false.

name: Παραλία Δάφνης (Εύβοια)
evidence: Dafni (Nerotrivias/Hiliadou) organized with sunbeds & umbrellas; a summer beach bar operates + Elia Beach Bar-Restaurant (eviaportal/theblogofdimi/restarttourism, independent of round1)

name: Παραλία Φάρου (Εύβοια)
evidence: Chalkida Faros area described as "organized with beach bars/loungers OR free beaches" — too ambiguous to confirm sunbeds at this exact pin.

name: Παραλία Έδεμ
evidence: Edem Palaio Faliro: sun loungers, umbrellas, changing cabins, showers, lifeguard; The PLACE beach bar at Poseidon Hotel (tropter/wondergreece, independent)

name: Αυλάκι (Ύδρα)
evidence: Avlaki Hydra organized with umbrellas/sunbeds/changing rooms + beach bar; €7 entrance incl. sunbeds and a bar with food/drinks (allovergreece/athens24)

name: Κομπονάδα (Κύθηρα)
evidence: Komponada: a beach bar offers sun loungers and umbrellas + WC/shower (greeka/destinationkythira, independent of round1)

name: Λιμνιώνας (Κύθηρα)
evidence: Limnionas: on-site canteen placed umbrellas and sun loungers on the shore (12€); a canteen not a full bar → beachBar left null (greeka/visitkythera)

name: Λύκος (Σφακιά)
evidence: Remote E4/boat cove; umbrellas + a few small hotels each with a taverna; the free sunbeds belong to Georgoshouse (hotel-private). No public sunbed rental / beach bar established.

name: Παραλία Θανάσης (Χανιά)
evidence: Only hit is "Thanasis Taverna" beach at Stavros (Akrotiri) — likely a beach named after a taverna, no organized-sunbed evidence. Possible data-quality/identity issue.

name: Χιόνα Παλαίκαστρου
evidence: "Slightly organized near the taverns"; 3 fish taverns + tamarisk shade (free). No explicit rentable sunbeds/beach bar. Blue Flag but taverna-beach character.

name: Άγιος Γεώργιος/Λιχνιστής (Ρέθυμνο)
evidence: Eastern cove (Lichnis) underdeveloped: some rooms, a small tavern, umbrellas. Umbrellas alone, no loungers/beach-bar confirmation.

name: Παραλία Λυγιάς (Πρέβεζα)
evidence: Ligia: shops offer free sunbeds & umbrellas for customers; beach bars/tavernas in the area (visitpreveza/travelpreveza, independent). Sunbeds present (customer model); beach bar left null.

name: Παντοκράτορας (Πρέβεζα)
evidence: Pantokratoras organized: sun loungers & umbrellas; at the Alonaki Beach section showers, parking, playground, beach volley and a beach bar (greece.com/sandee, independent)

name: Παραλία Καλάμι (Θεσπρωτία)
evidence: Kalami Sivota: loungers offered by the campsite and beach bars, coffee/snacks on the shore (casamatina/allsaints, independent of round1)

name: Glyfa Beach (Κέρκυρα)
evidence: Glyfa (Barbati-Nissaki, east coast) described only as a calm family beach; the organized sunbed/beach-bar evidence found belongs to Agios Georgios Pagon (different beach). Kept false.

name: Πούλιθρα (Λεωνίδιο)
evidence: Poulithra: organized beach with coffee bars; a named "Poulithra Beach Bar" operates on the sand (exploring-greece/inleonidio, independent)

name: Ζαρίτσι (Τυρός)
evidence: Pame Zaritsi Beach Bar on Zaritsi beach: sunbeds & umbrellas (3-5€), cafe; campsite + beach bar (choicegreece/tripadvisor, independent)

name: Παραλία Βερβένων (Αρκαδία)
evidence: The "organized" description belongs to the main Paralio Astros town beach; Vervena is one stretch 500m east of Kato Vervena in the 7km coast — cannot attribute organized sunbeds to this exact pin.

name: Άγιος Νικόλαος (Βοιωτία)
evidence: Antikyra Agios Nikolaos: organized with a beach bar and sunbeds on the right side + free sections (terrabook Boeotia, independent of the operator page)

name: Απόλλωνας (Νάξος)
evidence: naxos.net: Apollonas is NOT organized, no sunbeds/umbrellas, everything free (bring your own). Round1 over-read the waterfront tavernas.

name: Μουτσούνα (Νάξος)
evidence: Conflicting: most sources say not organized/no sunbeds; one mentions rentable sunbeds + Skala cafe-bar. Majority-unorganized → kept false.

name: Βάτσα (Κεφαλονιά)
evidence: Vatsa partly organized with sunbeds & umbrellas + a beach bar restaurant on the sand (greeka/terrabook/kefaloniabyanna, independent)

name: Καμπί (Κέα)
evidence: Kampi has NO sunbeds on the shore (trees/kiosks + a tavern nearby); the beach bars are at Koundouros 2-3min away. Round1 over-read the neighbour.

name: Αμμουδέλι (Πλωμάρι, Λέσβος)
evidence: Ammoudeli: deckchairs & umbrellas, showers, changing cabins, bars & restaurants; summer cafe serves at its sunbeds (greeka/visitplomari, independent)

name: Μπάλος (Σάμος)
evidence: Balos Marathokampos Samos: umbrellas & sunbeds, toilets; Esperos beach bar + Restaurant Balos on the sand (isamos/samosin, disambiguated from Balos Crete)

name: Κατσούνι (Ψαρά)
evidence: Marked as NOT organized; tamarisk shade + Spitalia cafe-restaurant at the end. No sunbed rental confirmed → kept false.

name: Φαρά (Λέσβος)
evidence: Described only as a quiet boat-access cove; no organized-facility detail found. Kept false.

name: Μεγάλη Άμμος (Σιθωνία)
evidence: Nikiti/Sithonia Megali Ammos: northern part organized with sunbeds & a beach bar, Blue Flag (travel.gr/gochalkidiki, disambiguated from Skiathos namesake)

name: Κότρωνας (Μάνη)
evidence: Kotronas/Nisaki: changing rooms/showers/wc + a beach bar with sun loungers (10€ set); Crown all-day bar on the beach (lakonia.mobi/exploring-greece)

name: Πεταλίδι (Μεσσηνία)
evidence: Petalidi: sunbeds & umbrellas for rent + the NAMASTE beach bar with tables on the sea (terrabook/messinia.mobi, independent)

name: Σιδερώνα (Κορινθία)
evidence: Siderona: sun loungers, showers and a bar; korinthiaguide lists it among the organized beaches of the region (independent of round1)

name: Γαλάζια Ακτή (Αν. Αττική)
evidence: Name ambiguity: Galazia Akti found at Schinias (a beach venue) vs Anavyssos bars — could not cleanly confirm sunbeds at this exact pin. Kept false.

name: Κεντρική Σαρωνίδας
evidence: Central Saronida is only partly organized with a handful of FREE straw umbrellas; the organized beach bars (Mavro Lithari, Ever Eden) are separate named beaches. Kept false.

name: Μικρή Ζωγεριά (Σπέτσες)
evidence: The organized sunbeds belong to the MAIN Zogeria bay; the smaller (Mikri) bay is described with only a taverna. Cannot attribute sunbeds to the small cove.

name: Άγιος Μηνάς (Φωκίδα)
evidence: Agios Minas near Drosia (Fokida): a canteen at the back provides umbrellas and sunbeds + tamarisk shade (travel.gr Central Greece, independent). Canteen not a bar → beachBar null.

name: Άγιος Μηνάς (Εύβοια)
evidence: Agios Minas (overlooking Chalkida): organized with sunbeds & umbrellas + showers; source explicitly says NO beach bar (taverns/ouzo only) (eviagreece, independent)

name: Κρύα Βρύση (Εύβοια)
evidence: Krya Vrysi (S. extension of Agia Anna): central organized section with umbrellas & sunbeds + a small canteen (voriaevia/eviagreece). Canteen → beachBar null.

name: Τσοκαΐτι (Εύβοια)
evidence: Tsokaiti (west of Istiaia): has organized areas with sunbeds (present tense); canteens/beach bars noted mostly in past years → beachBar left null.

name: Άη Γιαννάκης (Πρέβεζα/Πάργα)
evidence: feelgreece/travelparga: only a canteen + shaded seats; the beach does NOT have sunbeds/parasols — bring your own. Round1 over-read.

name: Σουβάλα (Εύβοια)
evidence: Could not find Evia/Nea Styra Souvala; all hits were Souvala Aegina. Kept false.

name: Σπήλιες (Ρέθυμνο)
evidence: Spilies/Latzimas: parasols & sunbeds + a canteen; "also a beach bar that offers sun loungers and umbrellas" (cretanbeaches/cretelocals, independent)

name: Βουρλιά (Λασίθι/Ξερόκαμπος)
evidence: Called a "large organised beach" with food/drink but no explicit sunbed/beach-bar evidence; Xerokampos is a largely wild area. Kept false.

name: Χαλατσές (Λέσβος)
evidence: No beach-specific source found (not featured in Lesvos guides). Kept false.

name: Παραλία Μύλων (Αργολίδα)
evidence: Myloi Argolida: organized beach (umbrellas/showers/changing rooms) + the named AQUA BEACH BAR on the sand (terrabook + argoliki news; our own site excluded as circular)

name: Αγία Βαρβάρα (Σκουτάρι, Λακωνία)
evidence: Skoutari Agia Varvara: sunbeds and umbrellas in some areas + tavernas (i-lovegreece/travelpeloponnisos). Fish taverns not a beach bar → beachBar null.
